#1
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं|ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śākham aśvattham|ūrdhva — upward, above (first member of ūrdhva-mūlam);;mūla — root (ūrdhva-mūlam: 'having its root above, upward-rooted', bahuvrīhi, acc. sg. neut., agreeing with aśvattham);;adhas — below, downward (adhaḥ: first member of adhaḥ-śākham; visarga retained before ś-, one of two options Pāṇini allows before a sibilant);;śākhā — branch (adhaḥ-śākham: 'having its branches below, downward-branched', bahuvrīhi, acc. sg. neut., agreeing with aśvattham);;aśvattha — the aśvattha, the sacred fig tree (Ficus religiosa) (acc. sg. neut., object of prāhuḥ; the three words are simply written joined, each final -m unaffected before the next sound)
प्राहुरव्ययम्|prāhuḥ avyayam|pra-ah — to declare, proclaim, call (prāhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl. used with an indefinite subject, 'they call, they declare'; -uḥ+a-→-ur a-);;a-vyaya — imperishable, undecaying (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with aśvattham, predicate complement of prāhuḥ)
--
छन्दांसि|chandāṃsi|chandas — a Vedic hymn, a sacred verse; also 'a meter' (nom. pl. neut., predicate)
यस्य|yasya|yad — whose, of which (gen. sg. neut., referring to the aśvattha)
पर्णानि|parṇāni|parṇa — leaf (nom. pl. neut., subject)
यस्तं|yaḥ tam|yad — who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative, subject; -aḥ+t-→-as t-);;tad — it, him (tam: acc. sg. masc., object of veda, referring to the tree)
वेद|veda|vid — to know (veda: perfect 3rd sg. used as present, 'knows')
स|sa|tad — he (sa: nom. sg. masc., subject, correlative)
वेदवित्|veda-vit|veda — the Veda (first compound member);;vid — knowing, a knower (agent noun from vid; veda-vit: 'a knower of the Veda', nom. sg. masc., predicate)
#2
अधश्चोर्ध्वं|adhaḥ ca ūrdhvam|adhas — below, downward (adhaḥ: adverb; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and (ca+ūrdhvam→cordhvam, a+ū→o);;ūrdhva — above, upward (ūrdhvam: adverb)
प्रसृतास्तस्य|prasṛtāḥ tasya|pra-sṛ — spread forth, extended (prasṛta: past participle, nom. pl. fem., predicate, agreeing with śākhāḥ; -āḥ+t-→-ās t-);;tad — its (tasya: gen. sg., referring to the tree of verse 1)
शाखा|śākhāḥ|śākhā — branch (nom. pl. fem., subject; the visarga of -āḥ is silently elided before the following voiced g- of guṇapravṛddhāḥ, carried across the pāda break — a pattern distinct from the more familiar -aḥ→-o, and recurring wherever a plural in -āḥ meets a voiced sound)
--
गुणप्रवृद्धा|guṇa-pravṛddhāḥ|guṇa — quality; the guṇas, kept untranslated in the idiomatic rendering per convention (first compound member);;pra-vṛdh — grown, increased (pravṛddha: past participle, guṇa-pravṛddhāḥ: 'nourished/increased by the guṇas', nom. pl. fem., agreeing with śākhāḥ; its own -āḥ likewise elides before the voiced v- of viṣaya- that follows)
विषयप्रवालाः|viṣaya-pravālāḥ|viṣaya — a sense-object, an object of the senses (first compound member);;pravāla — sprout, new shoot, tender twig (viṣaya-pravālāḥ: 'having sense-objects as their new shoots', nom. pl. fem., agreeing with śākhāḥ)
--
अधश्च|adhaḥ ca|adhas — below, downward (adhaḥ: adverb; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and
मूलान्यनुसंततानि|mūlāni anusaṃtatāni|mūla — root (mūlāni: nom. pl. neut., subject; -i+a-→-y a-);;anu-saṃ-tan — stretched out, extended continuously (anusaṃtata: past participle, nom. pl. neut., predicate, agreeing with mūlāni)
--
कर्मानुबन्धीनि|karma-anubandhīni|karman — action (first compound member; karma+anubandhīni→karmānubandhīni, a+a→ā);;anu-bandhin — binding to, entailing (from anu-bandh, 'to bind, entail consequences'; karma-anubandhīni: 'bound to action, entailing the consequences of action', nom. pl. neut., agreeing with mūlāni)
मनुष्यलोके|manuṣya-loke|manuṣya — man, human being (first compound member);;loka — world (manuṣya-loka: 'the human world', loc. sg.)
#3
न|na|na — not
रूपमस्येह|rūpam asya iha|rūpa — form, shape (rūpam: nom. sg. neut., subject; simply joined with asya, -m unaffected before the vowel);;tad — its (asya: gen. sg., referring to the tree);;iha — here, in this world (asya+iha→asyeha, a+i→e)
तथोपलभ्यते|tathā upalabhyate|tathā — thus, in that way (adverb; tathā+upalabhyate→tathopalabhyate, ā+u→o);;upa-labh — to perceive, apprehend (upalabhyate: present passive 3rd sg., 'is apprehended')
--
नान्तो|na antaḥ|na — not (na+antaḥ→nāntaḥ, a+a→ā);;anta — end (antaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before n-→-o)
न|na|na — not
चादिर्न|ca ādiḥ na|ca — and (ca+ādiḥ→cādiḥ, a+ā→ā);;ādi — beginning (ādiḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -iḥ+n-→-ir n-);;na — not, nor (repeated)
च|ca|ca — and
संप्रतिष्ठा|saṃpratiṣṭhā|sam-prati-sthā — foundation, resting-place, stable basis (nom. sg. fem., subject)
--
अश्वत्थमेनं|aśvattham enam|aśvattha — the aśvattha tree (acc. sg. masc., object of chittvā, resuming the tree of verses 1-2);;etad — this (enam: acc. sg. masc., emphatic, agreeing with aśvattham; simply joined, -m unaffected before the vowel)
सुविरूढमूल-|su-virūḍha-mūla(m)-|su — well, thoroughly (prefix, first member);;vi-ruh — grown up, sprung up (virūḍha: past participle, second member, 'well-grown');;mūla — root (third member; su-virūḍha-mūlam: 'having well-grown roots', bahuvrīhi, acc. sg. masc., agreeing with aśvattham enam — uniquely in this chapter the word's final -m is carried, by ordinary sandhi with the following vowel, onto the far side of the pāda break; this is an authentic feature of the transmitted text, reproduced here exactly as given and not a misprint — see the note)
--
मसङ्गशस्त्रेण|(-m) asaṅga-śastreṇa|mūla — root (this token opens with the -m that completes the previous line's mūlam, fused by sandhi with the following vowel and carried across the line break; -m+a-→ simply joined);;a-saṅga — non-attachment, freedom from attachment (first compound member of this word);;śastra — a weapon, a blade (asaṅga-śastra: 'the weapon of non-attachment', instr. sg.)
दृढेन|dṛḍhena|dṛḍha — firm, strong (instr. sg. neut., agreeing with śastreṇa)
छित्त्वा|chittvā|chid — to cut, sever (chittvā: gerund, 'having cut down')
#4
ततः|tataḥ|tatas — from that, then, thence (adverb)
पदं|padam|pada — place, state, station (nom. sg. neut., subject of the passive gerundive parimārgitavyam)
तत्परिमार्गितव्यं|tat parimārgitavyam|tad — that (tat: nom. sg. neut., in apposition with padam, 'that [state]');;pari-mārg — to seek out, track down (parimārgitavya: gerundive, 'is to be sought out', nom. sg. neut., agreeing with padam)
--
यस्मिन्गता|yasmin gatāḥ|yad — which (yasmin: loc. sg. neut. relative, 'into which, wherein');;gam — to go (gata: past participle, gatāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject, 'having gone [there]'; simply written joined, the nasal of yasmin unaffected before the consonant g-)
न|na|na — not
निवर्तन्ति|nivartanti|ni-vṛt — to turn back, return (nivartanti: present 3rd pl., 'they return')
भूयः|bhūyaḥ|bhūyas — again, once more (adverb)
--
तमेव|tam eva|tad — that, him (tam: acc. sg. masc., object of prapadye, referring forward to puruṣam);;eva — indeed, alone
चाद्यं|ca ādyam|ca — and (ca+ādyam→cādyam, a+ā→ā);;ādya — primal, original, first (ādyam: acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
पुरुषं|puruṣam|puruṣa — the Person (acc. sg. masc., object of prapadye)
प्रपद्ये|prapadye|pra-pad — to take refuge in, resort to (prapadye: present middle 1st sg., 'I take refuge in')
--
यतः|yataḥ|yatas — from whom, from which (adverb/relative, referring to puruṣam)
प्रवृत्तिः|pravṛttiḥ|pra-vṛt — activity, outgoing tendency, active engagement (nom. sg. fem., subject)
प्रसृता|prasṛtā|pra-sṛ — spread forth, issued forth (prasṛtā: past participle, nom. sg. fem., predicate, agreeing with pravṛttiḥ)
पुराणी|purāṇī|purāṇa — ancient, primeval (purāṇī: nom. sg. fem., agreeing with pravṛttiḥ)
#5
निर्मानमोहा|nirmāna-mohāḥ|nir-māna — free from pride, without self-conceit (nirmāna: first member of the bahuvrīhi);;moha — delusion (nirmāna-moha: 'free from pride and delusion', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., subject; the visarga of the plural -āḥ is elided before the following voiced j- of jitasaṅgadoṣāḥ, as at verse 2's śākhā and guṇapravṛddhā)
जितसङ्गदोषा|jita-saṅga-doṣāḥ|ji — conquered, overcome (jita: past participle, first member);;saṅga — attachment (second member);;doṣa — fault, flaw (jita-saṅga-doṣa: 'having conquered the fault of attachment', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc.; its own -āḥ elides before the following voiced a- of adhyātmanityāḥ)
--
अध्यात्मनित्या|adhyātma-nityāḥ|adhi-ātman — pertaining to the self, the inner self (adhyātma: first compound member, adhi+ātman→adhyātma, the same term named at 8.3);;nitya — constant, ever intent on (adhyātma-nitya: 'ever intent on the inner self', nom. pl. masc.; its -āḥ elides before the voiced v- of vinivṛttakāmāḥ)
विनिवृत्तकामाः|vinivṛtta-kāmāḥ|vi-ni-vṛt — turned back, ceased, withdrawn (vinivṛtta: past participle, first member);;kāma — desire (vinivṛtta-kāma: 'whose desires have ceased', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः|dvandvaiḥ vimuktāḥ|dvandva — a pair of opposites, a duality (dvandvaiḥ: instr. pl., 'by/from the dualities');;vi-muc — freed, released (vimukta: past participle, vimuktāḥ: nom. pl. masc., 'freed'; -aiḥ+v-→-air v-)
सुखदुःखसंज्ञै-|sukha-duḥkha-saṃjñaiḥ-|sukha — happiness, pleasure (first compound member);;duḥkha — pain, suffering (second member);;saṃjñā — name, designation (sukha-duḥkha-saṃjñā: 'called/designated pleasure and pain', instr. pl., in apposition with dvandvaiḥ — as at verse 3, the source splits this compound exactly at the point where its final visarga fuses by sandhi with the following gacchanti, carrying an 'r' onto the next printed line; reproduced here as given, not a misprint — see the note)
--
र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः|(-r) gacchanti amūḍhāḥ|gam — to go (gacchanti: present 3rd pl., 'they go'; its initial r completes the sandhi of saṃjñaiḥ from the previous line, -aiḥ+g-→-air g-; gacchanti+amūḍhāḥ→gacchantyamūḍhāḥ, -i+a-→-y a-);;a-mūḍha — undeluded, unconfused (amūḍhāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject, in apposition with all the preceding predicate adjectives)
पदमव्ययं|padam avyayam|pada — place, state (acc. sg. neut., object of gacchanti);;a-vyaya — imperishable (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with padam)
तत्|tat|tad — that (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with padam, resuming verse 4's tat parimārgitavyam)
#6
न|na|na — not
तद्भासयते|tat bhāsayate|tad — that (tat: acc. sg. neut., object of bhāsayate, referring to the padam of verse 5; -t+bh-→-d bh-);;bhās — to illumine, shine upon (causative; bhāsayate: present middle 3rd sg. used in an active sense, 'illumines')
सूर्यो|sūryaḥ|sūrya — the sun (nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before n-→-o)
न|na|na — not
शशाङ्को|śaśāṅkaḥ|śaśa — hare (first compound member);;aṅka — mark, spot (śaśa-aṅka: 'the hare-marked one', i.e. the moon, nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before n-→-o)
न|na|na — not
पावकः|pāvakaḥ|pāvaka — fire (nom. sg. masc., subject)
--
यद्गत्वा|yat gatvā|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, object of gatvā, referring to the imperishable state; -t+g-→-d g-);;gam — to go (gatvā: gerund, 'having gone [to which]')
न|na|na — not

#7
ममैवांशो|mama eva aṃśaḥ|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my');;eva — indeed (mama+eva→mamaiva, a+e→ai);;aṃśa — a part, a portion, a fragment (aṃśaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before j-→-o)
जीवलोके|jīva-loke|jīva — a living being, a soul (first compound member);;loka — world (jīva-loka: 'the world of living beings', loc. sg.)
जीवभूतः|jīva-bhūtaḥ|jīva — living, life (first compound member);;bhū — become (bhūta: past participle, jīva-bhūta: 'become a living being, a jīva', nom. sg. masc., predicate)
सनातनः|sanātanaḥ|sanātana — eternal, everlasting (nom. sg. masc., agreeing with aṃśaḥ)
--
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि|manaḥ-ṣaṣṭhāni indriyāṇi|manas — mind (first compound member; visarga retained before ṣ-, as at verse 1's adhaḥśākham);;ṣaṣṭha — sixth (manaḥ-ṣaṣṭha: 'with the mind as sixth', bahuvrīhi describing indriyāṇi; manaḥṣaṣṭhāni+indriyāṇi→manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi, -i+i-→-ī-, vowel lengthening);;indriya — a sense-organ, a faculty (indriyāṇi: acc. pl. neut., object of karṣati)
प्रकृतिस्थानि|prakṛti-sthāni|prakṛti — nature (first compound member);;stha — abiding in, situated in (prakṛti-sthāni: 'seated in nature', acc. pl. neut., agreeing with indriyāṇi)
कर्षति|karṣati|kṛṣ — to draw, drag (karṣati: present 3rd sg., 'draws [to itself]')
#8
शरीरं|śarīram|śarīra — body (acc. sg. neut., object of avāpnoti)
यदवाप्नोति|yat avāpnoti|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, object, referring to śarīram; -t+a-→-d a-, a final stop voiced before a vowel);;ava-āp — to obtain, acquire (avāpnoti: present 3rd sg., 'obtains')
यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः|yat ca api utkrāmati īśvaraḥ|yad — which, and (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, further object with ca; -t+c-→-c c-);;ca — and;;api — also, even (ca+api→cāpi, a+a→ā);;ud-kram — to go forth, depart (utkrāmati: present 3rd sg., 'departs'; api+utkrāmati→cāpyutkrāmati, -i+u-→-y u-);;īśvara — the lord, the ruling one — here the individual soul as controller of its own body and senses (nom. sg. masc., subject; utkrāmati+īśvaraḥ→utkrāmatīśvaraḥ, -i+ī-→-ī-)
--
गृहीत्वैतानि|gṛhītvā etāni|grah — to seize, take hold of (gṛhītvā: gerund, 'having taken hold of');;etad — these (etāni: acc. pl. neut., object of gṛhītvā, referring to the senses of verse 7; gṛhītvā+etāni→gṛhītvaitāni, ā+e→ai)
संयाति|saṃyāti|sam-yā — to go along with, proceed (saṃyāti: present 3rd sg., 'proceeds')
वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्|vāyuḥ gandhān iva āśayāt|vāyu — wind, air (vāyuḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject of the simile; -uḥ+g-→-ur g-);;gandha — scent, odor (gandhān: acc. pl. masc., understood object of an implied verb of carrying, completing the simile; simply joined with iva);;iva — like, as (particle of comparison);;āśaya — a receptacle, a resting-place (e.g. a flower) (āśayāt: abl. sg., 'from [its] resting-place'; iva+āśayāt→ivāśayāt, a+ā→ā)
#9

च|ca|ca — and

विषयानुपसेवते|viṣayān upasevate|viṣaya — a sense-object (viṣayān: acc. pl. masc., object of upasevate);;upa-sev — to resort to, enjoy, partake of (upasevate: present middle 3rd sg., 'partakes of')
#10
उत्क्रामन्तं|utkrāmantam|ud-kram — departing, going forth (utkrāmant: present participle, utkrāmantam: acc. sg. masc., object of anupaśyanti/paśyanti, referring to the soul)
स्थितं|sthitam|sthā — abiding, remaining (sthita: past participle, acc. sg. masc., 'remaining [in the body]')
वापि|vā api|vā — or (vā+api→vāpi, ā+a→ā);;api — also, even (emphatic)
भुञ्जानं|bhuñjānam|bhuj — enjoying, partaking of (bhuñjāna: present middle participle, acc. sg. masc., 'enjoying [the sense-objects]')
वा|vā|vā — or
गुणान्वितम्|guṇa-anvitam|guṇa — the guṇas, kept untranslated per convention (first compound member; guṇa+anvitam→guṇānvitam, a+a→ā);;anvita — accompanied by, united with (from anu-i; guṇa-anvita: 'united with the guṇas', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with the soul)
--
विमूढा|vimūḍhāḥ|vi-muh — deluded, confused (vimūḍha: past participle, vimūḍhāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; the visarga elides before the following voiced n- of na, as at verse 2's śākhā and verse 5's nirmānamohāḥ)
नानुपश्यन्ति|na anupaśyanti|na — not;;anu-dṛś — to perceive, see (anupaśyanti: present 3rd pl., 'they perceive'; na+anupaśyanti→nānupaśyanti, a+a→ā)
पश्यन्ति|paśyanti|dṛś — to see (paśyanti: present 3rd pl., 'they see')
ज्ञानचक्षुषः|jñāna-cakṣuṣaḥ|jñāna — knowledge (first compound member);;cakṣus — eye (jñāna-cakṣus: 'those whose eye is knowledge, those possessing the eye of knowledge', nom. pl. masc., subject)
#11
यतन्तो|yatantaḥ|yat — to strive, make effort (yatant: present participle, yatantaḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; -aḥ before y-→-o)
योगिनश्चैनं|yoginaḥ ca enam|yogin — a yogin (yoginaḥ: nom. pl. masc., in apposition with yatantaḥ; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and;;etad — this, it (enam: acc. sg. masc., object of paśyanti, referring to the self; ca+enam→cainam, a+e→ai)
पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्|paśyanti ātmani avasthitam|dṛś — to see (paśyanti: present 3rd pl.; paśyanti+ātmani→paśyantyātmani, -i+ā-→-y ā-);;ātman — the self (ātmani: loc. sg., 'in the self');;ava-sthā — abiding, situated (avasthita: past participle, acc. sg. masc., agreeing with enam; ātmani+avasthitam→ātmanyavasthitam, -i+a-→-y a-)
--
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो|yatantaḥ api akṛta-ātmānaḥ|yat — striving (yatant: present participle, yatantaḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;api — even, also (api+akṛtātmānaḥ→apyakṛtātmānaḥ, -i+a-→-y a-);;a-kṛta-ātman — one whose self is unaccomplished, unperfected (bahuvrīhi; akṛtātmānaḥ: nom. pl. masc., in apposition with yatantaḥ; -aḥ before n-→-o)
नैनं|na enam|na — not (na+enam→nainam, a+e→ai);;etad — him, it (enam: acc. sg. masc., object of paśyanti)
पश्यन्त्यचेतसः|paśyanti acetasaḥ|dṛś — to see (paśyanti: present 3rd pl.; paśyanti+acetasaḥ→paśyantyacetasaḥ, -i+a-→-y a-);;a-cetas — unintelligent, lacking discernment (acetasaḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject)
#12

क्षरश्चाक्षर|kṣaraḥ ca akṣaraḥ|kṣara — the Perishable, that which flows and decays (kṣaraḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and (ca+akṣaraḥ→cākṣaraḥ, a+a→ā);;a-kṣara — the Imperishable — literally 'not-flowing, not-decaying'; the same word also means, unrelatedly, 'a syllable', though not in that sense here (akṣaraḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate, second of the pair)
एव|eva|eva — indeed, too (akṣaraḥ+eva: the visarga of akṣaraḥ drops before the vowel with the hiatus retained rather than coalescing to -ai-, an accepted option in epic verse)
च|ca|ca — and (kṣaraḥ ca ... akṣaraḥ eva ca: 'both the Perishable and the Imperishable')
